messages.text:
The refund proposal is for **BRL 150.00**. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; a chat message won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

The shop can refund only to the original payment, not a new card. Since your original card was cancelled, its issuer handles any credit; the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear. (refund-policy/v2/payment)
The customer confirmed request prop-f936c8423cba4439 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

The refund of **BRL 150.00** has been recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt: **R-00000001**. This is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t give a date for when the credit may appear on your card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
